mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real estate sales (HOUST) indicates a strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where the proxy is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month signals a strong supply-side response, which boosts economic output and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 2% YoY and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals strong consumer demand and a tight labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% YoY, it signals inflationary pressure and monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where the proxy is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) increases by more than 2% YoY and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by less than 2% YoY, it signals strong economic growth without significant inflationary pressure, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY increase > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY increase < 2%
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where the trigger condition is met.
